amendments: Warm starts use independently certified derived reference poses, not unavailable original full-precision incumbents.

metrics.record_claims: exact registry comparison plus priority review required

notice: Local baseline improvements only; no world records established. Baselines are certified reconstructions, not original full-precision incumbents. Exact replay and ranking use selected certificates, never numeric_best. CPU hours are recorded search cost only and exclude certification; failed runs with unavailable CPU accounting are counted separately, not assumed to have cost zero. Summed certification wall hours are not CPU hours. Medians condition on valid runs; missing and failures remain visible. SVGs use floating-point rendering only. Recovery and meaningful improvement thresholds follow manifest.metrics (defaults 1e-5 and 1e-6). Success rates include failed completed runs as nonsuccesses and exclude missing runs. Wilson intervals are descriptive marginal intervals; common seeds pair arms, so these intervals do not test arm differences. Warm runs retain the exact baseline as a fallback: warm recovery is guaranteed by retention when certification succeeds, not evidence of rediscovery. Selected-baseline counts identify the unchanged witness; equal-baseline-bound counts also include other witnesses with exactly the same size.

source_comparison.notice: Comparison concerns a frozen source claim only. Candidate feasibility, source completeness, competing submissions, and record priority need separate evidence.

metrics.success_rate_denominator: completed tasks including failed or unverified runs; missing excluded
metrics.interval: 95% Wilson marginal descriptive intervals, not paired arm-comparison tests
